info.name: NEXUS PC API
info.description: Requests with assertions for every module, including negative cases. Run the folders in order with the 'NEXUS PC (local)' environment. The database must be seeded (npm run seed). No secrets are stored here: tokens are filled in by the login requests.

exec: pm.test("Uses the success envelope", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("data"); });
pm.test("Database is connected", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.database).to.eql("connected"); });
pm.test("Uses the success envelope", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("data"); });

pm.test("Role is customer and no password is returned", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.user.role).to.eql("customer"); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(b)).to.not.match(/password/i); });

item.name: Register with the same email again (duplicate)

exec: pm.test("Error code is EMAIL_TAKEN and the error shape is correct", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.error.code).to.eql("EMAIL_TAKEN"); pm.expect(b.error.message).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(b.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("Error code is VALIDATION_ERROR and the error shape is correct", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.error.code).to.eql("VALIDATION_ERROR"); pm.expect(b.error.message).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(b.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Lists the invalid fields", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); const fields = b.error.details.map((d) => d.field); pm.expect(fields).to.include.members(["name", "email", "password"]); });
pm.test("Uses the success envelope", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("data"); });
pm.test("Role is admin", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.user.role).to.eql("admin"); });

pm.test("Error code is INVALID_CREDENTIALS and the error shape is correct", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.error.code).to.eql("INVALID_CREDENTIALS"); pm.expect(b.error.message).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(b.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: Ask the assistant for a build (needs a Gemini key)

exec: pm.test("Either a grounded answer or a controlled fallback", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); if (pm.response.code === 503) { pm.expect(b.error.code).to.eql("AI_UNAVAILABLE"); } else { pm.expect(["ok", "no_match"]).to.include(b.data.status); pm.expect(b.data.aiAssisted).to.eql(true); } });
